Dieses Add-on wird zentral unter GLOBAL: This add-on is enabled centrally under GLOBAL.
Aktivierung und KI-Freigabe werden zentr: Activation and AI clearance are managed centrally under GLOBAL.
Sicherung und Diagnose für diese EMS-Ins: Backup and diagnostics for this EMS instance. Files are stored on the host (no browser download). Status under backup.* (last_file_name, last_sha256, export_register_ready, …).
Vor Neuinstallation oder Löschen der Ins: Always create this first before reinstalling or deleting the instance. Includes: admin config, mappings, vehicle profiles, policies and learning (price/PV/house load/stats).
Ablage: /opt/iobroker/iobroker-data/ems-: Location: /opt/iobroker/iobroker-data/ems-runtime.<instance>/exports/backup/  ·  Then check backup.last_file_name and last_sha256.
Anonymisierte Runtime-/Systeminfos, Logs: Anonymized runtime/system info, logs and deep detail JSON (e.g. wallbox) — for support and troubleshooting only, not for restoring the instance.
Export-Datei in den Restore-Inbox-Ordner: Place the export file into the restore inbox folder and run Restore in Admin — mappings and learning will return. Details: docs/EMS_LIGHT_FRESH_INSTALL_CHECKLIST.md
So starten Sie: 1) Geräte-Mappings setze: How to start: 1) Set device mappings (which ioBroker states EMS may read/write). 2) Keep each device on dryrun until everything looks right. 3) Only then switch to live. dryrun = EMS plans and shows but does not write devices. live = writes allowed. Both global and per-add-on must be live, otherwise it stays dryrun. AI optimization (later) also needs “AI optimization allowed” per add-on.
Der schwere Planner-Shadow/Takeover-Pfad: The heavy planner shadow/takeover path is disabled in this production build. EMS controls via failsafe + daily-plan logic. Later, AI can optimize plans per add-on (with clearance) — without writing devices directly.
